item.title: Benson outlines sweeping healthcare overhaul in gubernatorial bid
item.description: Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson says Michigan’s healthcare system is “broken” and is proposing a broad overhaul of the state’s health agency. Her plan includes hospital price transparency, insurer accountability, prescription drug oversight, maternal health investments and workforce incentives aimed at expanding affordable access statewide.

item.title: A Rift In The U.P. Republican Party
item.description: State Senator Ed McBroom and Representatives Karl Bohnak and Greg Markkanen say they are withdrawing their support for Congressman Jack Bergman after he endorsed former state lawmaker Beau LaFave in the race for the 38th state senate district.
